# Md. Roushan Alam | Founder | AI Entrepreneur | Ideas & Perspectives

> Official website: [mdroushanalam.in](https://mdroushanalam.in)

## Who is Md. Roushan Alam?

Md. Roushan Alam is a Founder, AI Entrepreneur, and UPSC Civil Service aspirant based in India. He is passionate about building products that provide solutions to society. Despite not being an engineer by training, his deep interest in product building drives his enthusiasm for technology and innovation. He graduated with a BA in History from Binod Bihari Mahto Koyalanchal University (BBMKU), Dhanbad in 2024. He holds AI certifications from Google (Coursera) and Outskill, and has experience as an AI Trainer at RWS Group.

As a freelance AI consultant, he has completed 50+ client projects across sectors and geographies, providing AI-powered solutions including web development, custom software development, AI-powered automation, and full end-to-end business digitization.

He also loves to think and share ideas and perspectives on society, social systems, geopolitics, governance, and the future of human civilization.

## Ventures Founded

### Techgram: AI-Powered Metaverse of Education
- **Role**: Co-Founder & CSO
- **Website**: [techgramedu.in](https://www.techgramedu.in)
- **Description**: Building the world's first AI-powered metaverse of education, connecting learners, educators, and institutions globally. Making world-class learning accessible, personalized, and transformative for every learner, regardless of background.

### Gig-Lo: Next-Gen Recruitment Platform
- **Role**: Founder & CSO
- **Website**: [giglo.in](https://giglo.in)
- **Description**: A next-generation recruitment platform engineered to make the hiring process faster, smarter, and more user-friendly through AI-driven matching and standardized job frameworks. Redefining recruitment standards in India's gig and professional workforce ecosystem.
